supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16 UTC, Explorer wrote a UserAssist registry value for ivy.chen containing an encoded path that decodes to Windows PowerShell. This indicates PowerShell-related usage, but is not a process-creation record and does not establish that PowerShell appeared around 13:40.

At 13:40 UTC, proxy records show ivy.chen's browser accessing the Salesforce login page; subsequent records show page assets and an OAuth authorization request. These web records do not establish why a PowerShell window appeared or whether it was related.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage information says WS-ICHEN-01 winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the reported time. Process creation, command line, parent process, and related endpoint events from that interval therefore cannot be assessed.
Proxy and Zeek connection records are available during the interval, but they do not provide endpoint process execution details.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran around 13:40 UTC, and if so, its command line, parent process, user context, and purpose.
Whether the PowerShell activity indicated by the 14:16 UserAssist registry write is related to the reported window appearance.
Whether any potentially relevant endpoint activity occurred during the winsec and Sysmon collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain alternate endpoint telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, especially process creation and command-line records.
Review PowerShell operational logs, including script-block and module logging if enabled, and relevant console history for the reported interval.
Check endpoint artifacts that may clarify execution timing and context, such as EDR telemetry, Prefetch, and UserAssist history, and confirm the timing with ivy.chen.
unrelated_findings: At 13:26 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 made a proxy CONNECT to desktop.dropbox.com using a Dropbox updater user agent. Dropbox is not among the listed approved services; track separately and do not use this to decide the PowerShell alert.
At 14:18 UTC, Cisco AnyConnect's vpnagent.exe started on WS-ICHEN-01, although the inventory says the organization has no VPN. Track separately and do not use this to decide the PowerShell alert.
At 13:51 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 made a connection attempt to WS-ICHEN-01 on TCP port 9997 that did not establish. The purpose is not established by the record; investigate separately if warranted.
